title: mespilus oxyacantha subvar. intermedia
intro: Mespilus oxyacantha subvar. intermedia, commonly known as Midland hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Central and Eastern Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Midland hawthorn include cardiotonic and diuretic effects, which can help alleviate cardiovascular issues and promote urinary function. The bioactive constituents of Mespilus oxyacantha subvar. intermedia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
